UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

CloseButton

Public wasm surface — one button canvas per instance.

click

click — registers a click for the shockwave ring: the bridge passes the frame clock's current seconds (the shader computes time - click_time for ring expansion/fade).

  • @param time The frame clock's current seconds.
  • @param {number} time

frame

frame — one animation tick: pack, write, draw.

  • @param dt Seconds since the previous call.
  • @param {number} dt

init

init — device + pipeline. Rejection → JS keeps the WebGL button; mounting can never regress the page.

  • @param canvas The widget's dedicated canvas.
  • @param device The shared GPUDevice (one per page, from the JS bridge).
  • @returns Ok on a live surface, Err(JsValue) on failure.
  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
  • @param {GPUDevice} device

constructor

CloseButton::new — un-initialized widget; init must follow.

resize

resize — canvas-bitmap change → surface re-configure.

  • @param _w Device-pixel width (element-side).
  • @param _h Device-pixel height.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_size

set_size — the canvas's CSS-pixel size (res + rect).

  • @param w Canvas width in CSS pixels.
  • @param h Canvas height in CSS pixels.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_state

set_state — bundled scalar update: liquid fill, X stroke progress, X rotation. All eased JS-side; the shader just draws.

  • @param liquid 0..1 fill height.
  • @param draw 0..1 X stroke progress.
  • @param rot X rotation in radians.
  • @param {number} liquid
  • @param {number} draw
  • @param {number} rot
